# x402 Finance API

> A pay-per-request cryptocurrency price API protected by the x402 micropayment protocol. Designed for autonomous AI agents and agentic systems. Agents can call the API, receive a 402 challenge, send 0.01 USDC on Base Sepolia, and retrieve real-time market data using the transaction hash as payment proof.

## Documentation

- [AGENT_GUIDE.md](AGENT_GUIDE.md) — Complete integration guide for autonomous agents, including payment flow, code examples, and error handling patterns.
- [README.md](README.md) — Project overview and basic usage information.

## Key Information

- **Live Endpoint:** https://x402-finance-api.onrender.com
- **Payment Model:** 0.01 USDC per request (exact)
- **Network:** Base Sepolia (testnet)
- **Payment Header:** `x-payment-tx`
- **Supported Queries:** Single asset via path parameter (e.g. `/crypto/bitcoin`, `/crypto/ethereum`)
